name: pc-control
description: Windows PC control bundle: Windows UI Automation (zero-screenshot element clicks), local Gemini Flash real-time worker, pc-operator flash subagent, batched GUI sequences, animated border-ring input lock with Ctrl+C abort, diagnostics, networking, power, and maintenance.
